Welcome to the Fallout Modding subverse. In this sticky, you'll find some good modlists from the inexperienced to the advanced.

Firstly, I highly recommend using Mod Organizer over Nexus Mod Manager. I find it to be more stable, easier for switching out mod installations, fantastic for sandboxing mods, and has LOOT built-in. It can be configured to open NMM links. For more, read this guide and watch Gopher's tutorials. He has some New Vegas-centric tutorials but I find the Skyrim one to be more comprehensive.

Some people have reported problems with Archive Invalidation in MO, while it works better in NMM. Personally, I've not had any problems that way, but fair warning.

And now, what mod installations can I recommend?

Modding Fallout 1

Many of the Fallout 1 mods have since been integrated into Fallout FIXT. This makes the game resolution work better on larger screens with scaling and can add in new/cut content. It is a merge of:

  • Official Interplay patches (1.1, 1.2)
  • TeamX patches (1.2, 1.21, 1.3.5)
  • No Children Fix
  • Cathedral Crash Fix (and other fixes by Sduibek for the Cathedral, Military Base and The Glow crashes)
  • Nimrod's Dialog Fixes
  • Fallout 1 Restoration Mod, version 1.0b1
  • Extended Flamer Attack Mod
  • Endgame Mod
  • TeamX NPCs 3.5
  • Sfall ddraw 1.18e
  • hires patch
  • Weapon Drop Mod [Created by Josan12 and MIB88]
  • "Nixie Numbers" for GUI

Installing any of those mods after installing Fallout FIXT will break your game.

DOWNLOAD FALLOUT FIXT

Modding Fallout 2

Similar to Fallout 1, Fallout 2 also has one big patch containing several smaller mods. This time, it's the Fallout 2 Restoration Project. This patch restores large amounts of cut content, the unofficial Fallout 2 patch, and the Fallout 2 High-resolution patch.

DOWNLOAD F2RP

Modding Fallout 3

Fallout 3 will make use of Mod Organizer. These mods are, simply put, the starting list. Some of them will overhaul the game and change how it works, some of them don't. I'll annotate all mods accordingly. These mods WILL conflict, so you may have to make choices to pick one mod over the other. The mod pages generally are good about telling you what mods work and what mods don't.

These mods will require FOSE.

FWE Fallout Wanderers Edition - A massive overhaul of Fallout 3 that mainly rebalances gameplay. Highly configurable.

MMM Marts Mutant Mod - Adds more variety to the creatures in Fallout 3. Lore-breaking.

Fellout - Removes the green tint from everything.

NMCs TEXTURE PACK - A massive texture overhaul. Has various size options and requires a fairly powerful PC.

Fallout 3 Redesigned - NPC redesign improvement.

Fallout 3 Reanimated - Improves the animation in Fallout 3.

Underground Hideout - Adds a Vault that the player can live in near Rivet City. Lore-breaking.

EVE - Energy Visuals Enhanced - Adds new kill animations, muzzle flashes, and more.

DC Interiors Project - Allows you to go inside more buildings in the Capital Wasteland.

RH Ironsights - Adds Ironsights (like in New Vegas) to vanilla guns.

Fallout street lights - Adds streetlights to the Wasteland.

RTS Real Time Settler - Settle a village and establish trade. This will be included in vanilla Fallout 4.

Enhanced Weather Rain and Snow - Adds rain and snow to the weather cycle.

FOOK2 - Similar to FWE, FOOK is a mechanic overhaul/rebalance mod. Lore-breaking.

Fallout Stutter Remover - FOSE required. Improves stuttering and/or performance.

Unofficial Fallout 3 Patch - A massive community-made bugfix mod.

Enhanced Blood Textures [Requires an INI file tweak] Adds better looking blood splatters.

Cube Experimental - A questmod exploring a dark secret in D.C. Lore-breaking.

iHud - Contextually shows and hides the HUD. Configurable.

Robco Certified - With RobCo Certification, you too can turn a hunk of junk into a brand-new robot assistant with our five-part correspondence course- get RobCo Robot Company certified, today!

Enhanced Night Sky - A high-resolution replacement for the default night sky taken from real astrophotography.

Sharing and Caring companions - Recruit anyone to be your companion!

MTUI - Essential UI adjustments for Fallout 3.

Terrain Pack - Adds high-res landscape/terrain textures.

A Note Easily Missed - A soft rustling sound catches your attention. Looking down, you see the wind has swept a tattered note against your foot...

Classic Fallout Weapons - Adds weapons from the classic Fallout games.

Pipboy Readius - A Pip-Boy device mod. I personally don't like it, as it looks too modern to be in the world. Changes the Pip-Boy into a Readius-styled device. Lore-breaking.

Hi-Res Weapons - Adds a high-res texture to many weapons.

CONELRAD 640-1240 Civil Defense Radio - This adds 55 music tracks from the Atomic era, and 29 authentic public-service announcements from Civil Defense!

Killable Children - Allows you to kill children, but there will be consequences!

A World of Pain - Adds many new locations made from vanilla game assets. Will extend the length of the game for completionists.

DYNAVISION Dynamic Depth of Field - DYNAVISION provides a dynamic depth-of-field and auto-focus effect similar to a camera.

For those looking for larger, more in-depth installations, check out Clear and Present Danger.

Modding Fallout: New Vegas

New Vegas is built on the same engine as Fallout 3, but with minor improvements and differences. Many mods from 3 were ported over to New Vegas, so some of them may be familiar. Like before, you will have to choose between certain mods, as some of these mods conflict. These are mostly the Pip-Boy mods and weather mods.

In fact, the game engines are so similar that Fallout 3 can actually be fully modded into New Vegas.

You will need NVSE.

Project Nevada - A massive overhaul mod, affecting every aspect of gameplay and balance. Fully configurable, with everal presets.

Project Nevda Extra Options - Extending options for Project Nevada.

New Vegas Bounties I - A well-done quest mod where you become a bounty hunter.

New Vegas Bounties II - Part 2 to the above.

Nevada Skies - Weather Effects - This modification adds weather effects such as sandstorms, rain, rainstorms, snow, radstorms and other weather variants to the game. Not compatible with Fellout or Projecgt Reality.

A world of Pain - Adds tons of new locations to the Wasteland. Made entirely from vanilla game assets. Possibly not lore-friendly, purists should stay away.

Weapon Mods Expanded WMX - Adds mods to every weapon in the vanilla game.

NMCs Texture Pack - A massive texture overhaul project. Does not retexture the DLCs.

Mod Configuration Menu MCM - Allows any number of mods to be configured from a single menu.

Underground Hideout New Vegas - Adds a Vault that the player can live in near Spring Mt. Ranch State Park. Not lore-friendly.

Weapon Retexture Project WRP - A huge weapon retexture pack.

Electro-City - Relighting the Wasteland - Adds streetlights and more to the Mojave.

uHud Unifed Hud Project - Use multiple HUD altering mods at the same time, without the hassle of manually editing xml files.

EVE - Essential Visual Enhanced - Adds more visuals and blood splatter, increasing the quality of many visual aspects of projectiles and other related aspects.

MTUI - Fallout: New Vegas UI improvements.

Pipboy Readius - Changes the Pip-Boy to a Readius. Not compatible with A Familiar Friend.

Weapon Animation Replacers - This mod allows you to change the animations of rifles and pistols.

Mission Mojave - This is the unofficial Fallout: New Vegas Ultimate Edition patch.

Fellout NV - Removes the orange tint. Not compatible with Nevada Skies or Project Reality.

Weapon Mod Menu - Provides a new weapon modification menu for adding/removing weapon mods.

New Vegas Stutter Remover - Fixes some performance issues.

Wasteland Flora Overhaul - Adds many new trees and plants. An option exists to make them appear alive or dead.

Underwater hideout - Adds a player home underwater. Lore-breaking.

Fook New Vegas - A overhaul for gameplay, balance, and more. Lore-breaking.

Classic Fallout Weapons - Adds many classic weapons from Fallout 1 and 2.

Enhanced Blood Textures - Increases the quality of blood splatters. Will require a powerful PC.

Fallout new Vegas Redesigned 2 - Improves character design based on realism and lore in New Vegas.

The New Bison Steve Hotel and Lucky Casino - Rebuild the Bison Steve Hotel and Lucky Casino from an empty structure to the Grand Opening and get a cut of the profit, two great player home options, unique weapons and armor and your own personal vendor.

Interior Lighting Overhaul - Modifies all interior cells giving them a realistic look. This mod aims to increase the immersion and creepiness of the fallout world, especially inside the vaults, caves and buildings. Lighting values are adjusted as well as the addition of lighting fixtures to the appropriate places where they were left out.

WME - Weapon Mods Expanded - Expands on the Vanilla weapon mod system, adding in a wide variety of new modifications.

Unlimited Companions - Allows you to have as many companions as you want all at once.

FNV Project Reality MKI - Adds new weather. Incompatible with Nevada Skies or Fellout.

New Vegas Restoration Project - Cleans up the Strip, making it look nicer.

Wasteland Defense - Construct your own wasteland fort and defend it from enemy raiders. Make your fort the safest place in the Mojave Wasteland! This will be included in vanilla Fallout 4.

Primary Needs Hud - Adds your levels of hunger, thirst, and sleep to the HUD in hardcore mode.

Populated Casinos - Adds NPCs to the casinos to give them more life. Options exist depending on your PC's capability.

NV Interiors Project - Adds interiors to the Mojave, similar to the mod for Fallout 3.

RTS Real Time Settler - Find a strategic location, start your village, establish trade routes and alliances, and fight for your freedom! This will be included in vanilla Fallout 4.

Enhanced Shaders ENB - A massive ENB/shaders preset. Improves everything across the board graphically, from AA to DoF. Requires a powerful PC.

iHud Immersive Hud - HUD when you need it. HIDE when you don't. Get the best of both worlds. The usefulness of having a HUD with the immersion of having none. Fully configurable.

Run the Lucky 38 -This mod allows you to build and manage almost every aspect of the Lucky 38. Manage the Casino, Cocktail Lounge, Museum and the Hotel! Uncover the secret of Mister House's legacy! Learn and create the Lucky 38's history!

A Familiar Friend - The Pipboy 2500 - The successor of the rugged Pip-Boy 2000 (as seen in Fallout 1 & 2) and the predecessor to the more recent arm-mounted Pip-Boy 3000. This is the Pip-Boy 2500. Not compatible with Pip-Boy Readius.

DYNAVISION 2 - Dynamic Lens Effect - DYNAVISION² provides a dynamic depth-of-field and auto-focus effect similar to a camera. Do not install this if you have Enhanced Shaders, it will make the DoF look weird.

Robco Certifed - With RobCo Certification, you too can turn a hunk of junk into a brand-new robot assistant with our five-part correspondence course- get RobCo Robot Company certified, today!

FOOK-PN Convergence - A massive patch that adds compatibility between Project Nevada, FOOK, WME, WMX, and Essential Visual Enhancements. It contains several patches for many mods to add compatibility.

And that's the starter list for New Vegas. If you want to try more in-depth, complex installations, try Fear and Loathing or (for the skilled and brave) the Definitive List.
